title: ACB system down in zone 5 at UPS Fort Worth (Haslet); recovery reported after robot 158 was removed from the system

site.notes: Case metadata consistently references UPS Fort Worth, TX (Haslet). A later work-order screenshot also references Fort Worth / Haslet hub, but OCR is noisy.

notes: Elapsed time reflects case-tracking duration, not independently verified physical downtime.

incident_description: A high-priority production-impacting incident was opened for UPS Fort Worth (Haslet) with subject 'ACB System Down.' Source text says the site reported zone 5 was unable to get a pair. Supporting case text says an AMR with low battery was under the rack, the site replaced the AMR, and every AMR went to the hospital. Internal support discussion considered RMS roster/add-remove issues. Later evidence states robot 158 was removed from the system and placed on charger; after that, the system reportedly began functioning again and remained operational during a short monitoring period.
customer_operational_impact: Production was seriously impacted. The reported operational effect was loss of pairing capability in zone 5 and abnormal AMR behavior routing to the hospital lane.
what_resolved_it: Source-supported recovery action was removal of robot 158 from the system, with the robot placed on charger. Case notes then report the system began functioning again and remained operational during approximately 10 minutes of monitoring before the case was resolved and closed.
follow_up_required: SME review recommended for possible mapping/roster issue involving robot 158; source says robot 158 was shown as not mapped.
SME review recommended for terminology inconsistency where source references both ACB system and ECB system.
Confirm whether KPI duration should be treated as case elapsed time versus actual customer downtime.
support_boundary: Support evidence shows remote incident handling, escalation, case management, and validation of reported recovery. A CBRE/work-order path was also referenced for site/vendor response. Evidence does not support a confirmed root cause.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Case 00228723 created at 7:36 PM with subject ACB System Down, account UPS Fort Worth, TX (Haslet), priority 2 - High: Production seriously impacted.
Description says zone 5 was unable to get a pair; AMR had low battery under the rack; site replaced the AMR; every AMR goes to the hospital.
RMS screenshot context includes visible note stating site removed robot 158 from system.
Support update says robot 158 was removed, but zone 5 was still having issues at that time; later update says site believed removing robot 158 may have fixed the issue and the system began working.

At 9:17 PM, support update says site removed robot 158 from the system, currently on charger; after removing robot 158, the system began functioning again and remained operational during about 10 minutes of monitoring.
At 9:20 PM, case status updated from Escalated to Resolved and case closed.
Work-order screenshot shows emergency/dispatched maintenance context for Haslet hub and references ACB repair in zone 5, though OCR is noisy.

conflicts_or_ambiguities: Source text references both ACB system down and ECB system functional again.

Robot 158 removal appears in evidence before and after recovery; one support update says zone 5 issues persisted after removal, while later updates say the system began functioning again after removal.
Case elapsed time is well supported, but exact customer downtime is not independently verified.
unsupported_or_missing_details: No direct telemetry proving full system health after recovery beyond reported monitoring and case closure.
No exact start time for the physical outage before case creation.
